summary.zh: 整理提示词迭代、成功标准与常见设计方法。
summary.en: An overview of prompt iteration, success criteria and design techniques.

why.zh: 先定义什么算成功，再比较提示词是否有效。
why.en: Define success criteria before comparing prompt changes.

title.zh: ChatGPT 通用 AI 助手

summary.zh: 体验文本、多模态与任务协作的对话入口。
summary.en: A conversational interface for text, multimodal and task assistance.

why.zh: 用同一真实任务反复验证输出；核对来源与事实。
why.en: Evaluate it on a real task and verify sources and facts.

summary.zh: 从安装、理解项目到修改代码与运行测试，完成一次 AI 编程流程。
summary.en: Complete an AI coding workflow from setup and project exploration to code changes and tests.

why.zh: 用一个可验证的小改动练习协作。
why.en: Practice collaboration through one verifiable small change.

summary.zh: 用于写作、分析与编程的对话式工具。
summary.en: A conversational tool for writing, analysis and coding.

why.zh: 与其他工具使用相同输入比较效果和限制。
why.en: Compare results and limitations using the same inputs across tools.

title.zh: Descript 文本式音视频编辑

summary.zh: 通过转写文本编辑音频和视频内容。
summary.en: Edit audio and video through their transcripts.

why.zh: 适合采访、播客和讲解视频的初步整理。
why.en: Useful for a first pass on interviews, podcasts and explainers.

summary.zh: 体验 Google 的通用与多模态助手。
summary.en: Explore Google’s general-purpose and multimodal assistant.

why.zh: 用图片、文档和文字任务理解多模态交互。
why.en: Explore multimodal interaction through images, documents and text.

title.zh: Hugging Face 大语言模型课程

summary.zh: 从 Transformer、分词与数据集走到模型训练和使用。
summary.en: Learn transformers, tokenization, datasets and model training.

why.zh: 把模型概念和可运行的 Python 实践连接起来。
why.en: Connect model concepts to runnable Python practice.

title.zh: LM Studio 本地模型指南

summary.zh: 通过桌面界面下载模型、开始对话并了解本地运行方式。
summary.en: Download models and chat through a desktop interface while learning local execution.

why.zh: 适合不想先配置命令行的本地模型使用者。
why.en: A starting point for local models without beginning in a terminal.

summary.zh: 把文字观点转换成可编辑的图解和视觉表达。
summary.en: Turn written ideas into diagrams and visual explanations.

why.zh: 适合说明流程、关系和比较，而不只是配装饰图。
why.en: Explain processes, relationships and comparisons visually.

summary.zh: 围绕提供的资料进行整理、提问与学习。
summary.en: Organize, question and study a supplied collection of materials.

why.zh: 从你熟悉的资料开始，比较摘要与原文是否一致。
why.en: Start with familiar materials and compare summaries with the originals.

title.zh: Ollama 本地模型快速入门

summary.zh: 安装并运行本地模型，学习基础调用方式。
summary.en: Install and run local models and learn basic invocation patterns.

why.zh: 第一次体验模型在自己的设备上运行；按硬件选模型。
why.en: Try running models on your own hardware and choose models accordingly.

summary.zh: 学习用明确指令、上下文和示例组织模型输入。
summary.en: Structure model inputs with clear instructions, context and examples.

why.zh: 通过可复现的任务要求改进输出，而非收集万能咒语。
why.en: Improve outputs with reproducible task requirements and examples.

summary.zh: 使用在线音频工具改善语音录制和处理流程。
summary.en: Use online audio tools to improve speech recording and processing.

why.zh: 对比处理前后的人声清晰度与失真。
why.en: Compare speech clarity and artifacts before and after processing.

summary.zh: 在已有 Git 项目里与模型协作修改代码。
summary.en: Collaborate with a model on code changes in an existing Git project.

why.zh: 通过差异和测试检查模型改了什么。
why.en: Use diffs and tests to inspect model changes.

title.zh: Google AI Studio 模型实验台

summary.zh: 在浏览器中试验模型输入与应用原型。
summary.en: Experiment with model inputs and application prototypes in a browser.

why.zh: 认识聊天界面之外的开发与参数调试方式。
why.en: Explore development and parameter experimentation beyond chat interfaces.

summary.zh: 介绍工作流、智能体与常见组件组织方式。
summary.en: Discusses workflows, agents and common component patterns.

why.zh: 理解什么时候简单工作流已经足够。
why.en: Learn when a simpler workflow is sufficient.

summary.zh: 连接模型和自己的文档，搭建可使用的知识问答空间。
summary.en: Connect models and your documents to create a knowledge chat workspace.

why.zh: 用自己的资料检验检索问答是否真的有帮助。
why.en: Test retrieval against documents you know well.

summary.zh: 把 AI 生成内容接入海报、演示和日常设计流程。
summary.en: Bring AI-generated content into posters, presentations and everyday design.

why.zh: 适合需要把内容排成可交付页面的人。
why.en: Useful when generated content needs a finished layout.

summary.zh: 通过桌面工作台连接模型并组织日常 AI 任务。
summary.en: Connect models and organize everyday AI tasks through a desktop workspace.

why.zh: 减少在不同模型入口间来回切换。
why.en: Keep everyday model work in one place.

title.zh: Codex 命令行编程智能体

summary.zh: 在终端中理解项目、修改代码并检查结果。
summary.en: Explore projects, edit code and inspect results from the terminal.

why.zh: 把需求、代码差异和测试串成一次完整协作。
why.en: Connect a request, a code diff and tests in one workflow.

summary.zh: 体验代码补全、问答和开发辅助工作流。
summary.en: Explore code completion, questions and development assistance.

why.zh: 观察它在哪些任务省时、哪些任务仍需人工验证。
why.en: Observe where assistance saves time and where manual verification remains necessary.

summary.zh: 改写和润色文本，比较措辞、语气与表达方式。
summary.en: Revise writing and compare phrasing, tone and expression.

why.zh: 逐句核对改写是否保留了原意。
why.en: Review each rewrite for preserved meaning.

title.zh: DeepSeek 中文 AI 助手

summary.zh: 用日常问题练习提问、追问和核对答案。
summary.en: Practice questions, follow-ups and answer checking in a chat interface.

why.zh: 先用熟悉的问题比较回答，建立验证习惯。
why.en: Start with familiar questions to build a habit of checking answers.

summary.zh: 通过可视化工作流组织模型、知识与工具。
summary.en: Organize models, knowledge and tools through visual workflows.

why.zh: 适合先构建应用原型，再理解背后的各个环节。
why.en: Prototype an app and then inspect its underlying stages.

summary.zh: 把 PDF、办公文档和图片转换为模型更易处理的结构化内容。
summary.en: Convert PDFs, office documents and images into structured model-ready content.

why.zh: 先把文档读对，再做总结或知识库。
why.en: Improve document extraction before summarization or retrieval.

summary.zh: 从日常问答与内容草稿开始尝试 AI 协作。
summary.en: Try AI collaboration through everyday questions and content drafts.

why.zh: 用简单任务观察补充条件怎样改变回答。
why.en: Observe how adding requirements changes the response to a simple task.

title.zh: Elements of AI：非技术读者入门

summary.zh: 用概念、实例与练习解释 AI 能做什么和不能做什么。
summary.en: Concepts, examples and exercises explaining AI capabilities and limitations.

why.zh: 没有编程背景也能先建立判断 AI 产品的基本框架。
why.en: Build a framework for evaluating AI products without a coding background.

summary.zh: 用文字生成语音并尝试音频创作功能。
summary.en: Generate speech from text and explore audio creation tools.

why.zh: 用一段短旁白检查发音、语气与可编辑性。
why.en: Test pronunciation, delivery and editability with a short narration.

summary.zh: 围绕研究问题搜索论文并整理证据。
summary.en: Search papers around a research question and organize evidence.

why.zh: 回到原文核对结论，减少只读模型总结。
why.en: Check claims in the original papers rather than relying only on summaries.

summary.zh: 把想法与资料组织成演示文稿或页面初稿。
summary.en: Turn ideas and source material into presentation or page drafts.

why.zh: 适合先搭结构，再人工检查论点和版面。
why.en: Draft a structure before reviewing claims and layout.

summary.zh: 通过官方示例理解清晰任务、样例和多模态输入。
summary.en: Official examples for clear tasks, examples and multimodal inputs.

why.zh: 比较不同模型的输入习惯，避免只记单一产品技巧。
why.en: Compare input practices across models instead of memorizing one product.

summary.zh: 为 Python 函数和模型添加可交互的网页界面。
summary.en: Add a web interface to Python functions and models.

why.zh: 把实验变成别人能试用的演示。
why.en: Turn an experiment into a demo others can try.

summary.zh: 用配套示例理解表示、生成、检索与模型应用。
summary.en: Companion examples on representations, generation, retrieval and applications.

why.zh: 适合希望同时理解概念与应用模式的读者。
why.en: Connect concepts with practical LLM application patterns.

summary.zh: 学习模型如何调用工具并组织多步任务。
summary.en: Learn how models call tools and organize multi-step tasks.

why.zh: 适合做过基础聊天应用后理解智能体的边界和实现。
why.en: A next step after a basic chat app to understand agent implementation and limits.

title.zh: Hugging Face Spaces 应用展示指南

summary.zh: 发布可交互的机器学习演示并分享给其他人试用。
summary.en: Publish interactive machine learning demos that others can try.

why.zh: 把本地实验变成别人能打开的应用入口。
why.en: Turn a local experiment into a shareable app.

summary.zh: 通过桌面客户端运行本地模型并对话。
summary.en: Run and chat with local models through a desktop application.

why.zh: 适合从下载模型到实际对话完整体验本地 AI。
why.en: Try the full local-model path from download to conversation.

title.zh: 即梦 AI 图像与视频创作

summary.zh: 从中文提示词或图片开始制作图像与视频。
summary.en: Create images and video from Chinese prompts or reference images.

why.zh: 练习主体、画面风格和运动描述的组合。
why.en: Practice combining subject, visual style and motion descriptions.

summary.zh: 从具体任务出发，练习把需求交给 AI 并检查结果。
summary.en: Practice delegating a concrete task to AI and reviewing its result.

why.zh: 用同一项任务比较需求是否表达清楚。
why.en: Use a concrete task to check whether your instructions are clear.

summary.zh: 在 Krita 中结合手工绘画、局部重绘和 AI 生成。
summary.en: Combine painting, inpainting and AI generation inside Krita.

why.zh: 适合已有画面构图、需要局部修改的创作者。
why.en: Useful for creators who want controlled changes to an existing composition.

summary.zh: 从读取文档、建立索引到检索后回答。
summary.en: Load documents, build an index and answer after retrieval.

why.zh: 通过一个小项目理解 RAG 各环节的作用。
why.en: Understand the stages of RAG through a small project.

summary.zh: 用可视化界面检查 MCP 服务提供的工具和响应。
summary.en: Inspect an MCP server and its tool responses through a visual interface.

why.zh: 连接失败时先看实际请求与返回值。
why.en: Inspect actual requests and responses when an integration fails.

summary.zh: 把模型、工具和记忆接入可视化自动化流程。
summary.en: Connect models, tools and memory in visual automation workflows.

why.zh: 把一次聊天变成可以重复执行的任务。
why.en: Turn a chat task into a repeatable workflow.

title.zh: AI 应用评估实践指南

summary.zh: 用测试样本、评价标准和持续评估衡量模型输出。
summary.en: Measure model outputs with datasets, criteria and repeated evaluation.

why.zh: 避免凭几次漂亮演示就认为应用可靠。
why.en: Evaluate reliability beyond a few convincing demos.

summary.zh: 识别图片和扫描文档中的文字及布局。
summary.en: Recognize text and layout in images and scanned documents.

why.zh: 给扫描资料建立可搜索的文字底稿。
why.en: Create searchable text from scanned material.

summary.zh: 学习表格读取、清洗、筛选、合并与统计。
summary.en: Learn table loading, cleaning, filtering, merging and aggregation.

why.zh: 把真实数据整理成可以分析和训练的输入。
why.en: Prepare real-world data for analysis and training.

summary.zh: 体验带有来源链接的搜索与回答流程。
summary.en: Explore search and answers accompanied by source links.

why.zh: 练习从回答回到原始来源，检验引用是否支持结论。
why.en: Return to original sources and check whether citations support claims.

summary.zh: 用可重复的测试集比较提示词和模型输出。
summary.en: Compare prompts and model outputs with repeatable test cases.

why.zh: 把感觉更好变成可检查的输出差异。
why.en: Replace vague impressions with inspectable output differences.

title.zh: Pydantic AI 结构化智能体指南

summary.zh: 用 Python 定义工具、输出结构和智能体流程。
summary.en: Define tools, structured outputs and agent workflows in Python.

why.zh: 适合已经会调用模型、需要可检查输出的人。
why.en: Useful after basic model calls when output needs validation.

summary.zh: 把文本编码为向量，用于相似度、搜索和检索。
summary.en: Encode text as vectors for similarity, search and retrieval.

why.zh: 动手理解 embedding，而不只记住这个术语。
why.en: Understand embeddings by building with them.

summary.zh: 使用现成模型完成常见文本、图像和音频任务。
summary.en: Use pretrained models for common text, image and audio tasks.

why.zh: 先做出一次本地推理，再深入模型内部。
why.en: Complete an inference task before exploring model internals.

summary.zh: 提供语音识别模型与参考推理代码。
summary.en: Speech recognition models and reference inference code.

why.zh: 以转写任务进入音频 AI，并观察语言和噪声的影响。
why.en: Start audio AI with transcription and examine language and noise effects.

summary.zh: 在开发环境里让智能体读取项目并完成可审查的修改。
summary.en: Let an agent explore a project and produce reviewable code changes.

why.zh: 从小任务练习文件修改与执行步骤的审查。
why.en: Practice reviewing edits and execution steps on a small task.

summary.zh: 把 AI 编程辅助接入开发工作流。
summary.en: Bring an AI coding agent into a development workflow.

why.zh: 适合比较不同模型与已有开发工具的配合。
why.en: Compare how models fit an existing development setup.

summary.zh: 在编辑器中体验 AI 辅助理解、修改与生成代码。
summary.en: Use AI to understand, edit and generate code in an editor.

why.zh: 从小型可测试修改开始，逐行审查生成代码。
why.en: Start with small testable changes and review generated code.

title.zh: Hugging Face 数据集快速入门

summary.zh: 介绍加载、检查和处理机器学习数据集。
summary.en: Load, inspect and process machine learning datasets.

why.zh: 避免把数据准备视为模型训练之外的小事。
why.en: Treat data preparation as part of the learning workflow.

summary.zh: 组合知识库检索与可视化 AI 工作流。
summary.en: Combine knowledge retrieval with visual AI workflows.

why.zh: 先完成一个资料问答，再增加处理步骤。
why.en: Build a document question-answering task before adding steps.

summary.zh: 将网页提取为适合后续检索和模型处理的数据。
summary.en: Extract web pages into data suitable for retrieval and model workflows.

why.zh: 解决给模型准备网页资料的具体步骤。
why.en: Learn a concrete way to prepare web sources for a model.

summary.zh: 通过 Adobe 的创作界面生成和编辑视觉内容。
summary.en: Generate and edit visual content through Adobe creative tools.

why.zh: 从一张可修改的素材开始练习生成式编辑。
why.en: Start with one editable asset to practice generative editing.

title.zh: Flowise 可视化 AI 工作流

summary.zh: 使用可视化界面搭建 AI 应用流程。
summary.en: Build AI application flows through a visual interface.

why.zh: 观察输入、模型和工具之间的数据如何流动。
why.en: Observe data flowing between inputs, models and tools.

summary.zh: 在终端中使用 Gemini 执行编程与工具任务。
summary.en: Use Gemini for coding and tool tasks in the terminal.

why.zh: 适合已有终端习惯的人从一个项目开始。
why.en: Start with one project if you already use a terminal.

title.zh: Goose 可扩展任务智能体

summary.zh: 把模型与工具连接起来，执行开发和日常多步任务。
summary.en: Connect models and tools for development and multi-step tasks.

why.zh: 用具体小任务了解工具接入和执行边界。
why.en: Explore tool integration and execution boundaries on a concrete task.

title.zh: 海螺 AI 视频创作

summary.zh: 尝试视频生成，练习描述动作、镜头与参考画面。
summary.en: Explore video generation by describing actions, shots and reference imagery.

why.zh: 适合用短镜头练习提示词与成片之间的对应关系。
why.en: Use short shots to compare a prompt with its generated result.

title.zh: Hugging Face 音频 AI 课程

summary.zh: 介绍音频数据、语音识别与语音生成的工作流。
summary.en: Explore audio data, speech recognition and speech generation workflows.

why.zh: 想做语音应用时，先理解采样率、音频表示和任务区别。
why.en: Understand sampling, audio representations and task differences before building voice apps.

title.zh: 如何阅读与编写模型卡

summary.zh: 了解模型用途、训练背景、局限和使用说明。
summary.en: Understand intended uses, training context, limitations and usage notes.

why.zh: 下载模型前先判断它是否适合任务与部署条件。
why.en: Assess a model before downloading or deploying it.

summary.zh: 通过提示词生成和迭代视觉素材。
summary.en: Generate and iterate on visual assets from prompts.

why.zh: 用相同构图需求比较多版结果。
why.en: Compare variations against the same composition brief.

summary.zh: 通过可视化界面生成和编辑图像。
summary.en: Generate and edit images through a visual creative interface.

why.zh: 把生成图片放进可以反复修改的创作流程。
why.en: Bring image generation into an iterative editing workflow.

summary.zh: 用可运行的语音合成项目把文字转为音频。
summary.en: Turn text into audio with a runnable speech synthesis project.

why.zh: 先制作短旁白，比较发音与停顿。
why.en: Begin with a short narration and inspect pronunciation and pauses.

summary.zh: 记录模型应用的调用过程、提示词和评估结果。
summary.en: Trace model calls, prompts and evaluation results in an application.

why.zh: 排查多步任务哪里出错以及成本花在哪里。
why.en: Find where a multi-step task fails and where cost accumulates.

summary.zh: 生成和编辑图像、视频创意素材。
summary.en: Generate and edit image and video creative assets.

why.zh: 适合通过多轮迭代探索视觉方案。
why.en: Explore visual directions through iterative generation.

summary.zh: 在统一界面中组织多个模型与聊天工具。
summary.en: Organize multiple models and chat tools in one self-hosted interface.

why.zh: 适合已有接口、希望自己管理聊天工作台的人。
why.en: Useful when you have model access and want to manage the chat workspace.

summary.zh: 使用 C/C++ 在多种硬件上运行语言模型。
summary.en: Run language models on varied hardware with C/C++.

why.zh: 了解量化、本地推理与硬件约束的实际含义。
why.en: Explore quantization, local inference and hardware constraints.

summary.zh: 将 PDF 转成 Markdown 或 JSON，供搜索和后续处理使用。
summary.en: Convert PDFs to Markdown or JSON for search and downstream processing.

why.zh: 用真实复杂页面比较表格和段落转换结果。
why.en: Compare table and paragraph extraction on real pages.

summary.zh: 通过可视化平台构建知识问答和智能体应用。
summary.en: Build knowledge chat and agent applications through a visual platform.

why.zh: 适合从内部资料问答开始验证场景。
why.en: Start by testing questions against your own reference material.

summary.zh: 了解 AI 应用连接外部工具与数据的标准接口。
summary.en: Understand a standard interface for connecting AI apps with tools and data.

why.zh: 先弄清客户端、服务端和授权边界，再安装工具。
why.en: Understand clients, servers and authorization before connecting tools.

summary.zh: 把工作拆成具体任务，体验智能体执行与结果检查。
summary.en: Break work into concrete tasks and review an agent’s execution and output.

why.zh: 从边界清楚的小任务开始，再逐步增加步骤。
why.en: Start with a small, well-defined task before adding more steps.

summary.zh: 了解数组、形状、索引与数值计算。
summary.en: Understand arrays, shapes, indexing and numerical operations.

why.zh: 理解张量前先熟悉数组，减少形状错误。
why.en: Get comfortable with arrays before tensors and shape debugging.

title.zh: Open Notebook 资料研究工作台

summary.zh: 自托管资料整理、问答和内容研究工作流。
summary.en: Self-host source organization, question answering and research workflows.

why.zh: 适合希望自己管理资料与模型选择的人。
why.en: Useful when you want control over sources and model selection.

summary.zh: 通过开源编程智能体在项目中使用模型。
summary.en: Use models in a project through an open-source coding agent.

why.zh: 适合想比较不同模型编程工作流的人。
why.en: Useful for comparing coding workflows across models.

summary.zh: 通过统一接口尝试不同模型并接入已有应用。
summary.en: Try different models through one interface and connect them to an app.

why.zh: 适合做小规模模型比较，先了解费用和接口条件。
why.en: Useful for small model comparisons after checking access and costs.

title.zh: Open WebUI 自托管交互界面

summary.zh: 为模型提供可自托管的网页交互界面。
summary.en: A self-hostable web interface for model interaction.

why.zh: 搭建自己的使用入口，同时了解账号与部署设置。
why.en: Build your own interface and learn deployment and account settings.

summary.zh: 学习语法、数据结构、模块与异常处理。
summary.en: Learn syntax, data structures, modules and exception handling.

why.zh: 建立阅读和修改 AI 示例代码所需的语言基础。
why.en: Build the language skills needed to read and modify AI examples.

summary.zh: 用中文描述问题、补充背景，练习多轮沟通。
summary.en: Practice multi-turn assistance with Chinese questions and context.

why.zh: 适合从日常写作和问答开始熟悉 AI。
why.en: Start with everyday writing and questions to explore AI assistance.

summary.zh: 把文档解析、检索和问答组合成知识应用。
summary.en: Combine document parsing, retrieval and question answering.

why.zh: 对照原文检查知识库答案和检索结果。
why.en: Check knowledge-base answers against retrieved sources.

summary.zh: 生成适合设计工作流的图像素材。
summary.en: Generate visual assets for design workflows.

why.zh: 围绕同一风格练习成组素材的一致性。
why.en: Practice consistency across a set of assets in one visual style.

summary.zh: 体验生成式视觉与视频创作工具。
summary.en: Explore generative visual and video creation tools.

why.zh: 用短场景测试镜头、运动和角色一致性的局限。
why.en: Test motion, framing and character consistency with short scenes.

title.zh: 讯飞星火 AI 助手

summary.zh: 体验写作、文档问答与录音纪要等办公任务。
summary.en: Explore writing, document questions and recorded meeting notes.

why.zh: 从真实办公任务练习给背景、定格式和验收结果。
why.en: Practice context, output formats and result checking on a real work task.

summary.zh: 用 Python 构建可交互的数据与 AI 应用。
summary.en: Build interactive data and AI applications in Python.

why.zh: 适合快速展示数据、模型输出和反馈。
why.en: Quickly present data, model outputs and feedback controls.

summary.zh: 在字幕编辑器中整理、校对和同步字幕，并使用语音识别功能。
summary.en: Edit, proofread and synchronize subtitles with speech recognition support.

why.zh: 自动转写后仍需要可以逐句修正的工具。
why.en: Keep a practical way to correct automatic transcripts line by line.

summary.zh: 根据文字描述生成音乐并探索不同风格。
summary.en: Generate music from text descriptions and explore different styles.

why.zh: 先做短音乐草稿，检查结构与情绪是否合适。
why.en: Start with a music sketch and check its structure and mood.

summary.zh: 从文字需求生成网页界面与应用原型。
summary.en: Generate web interfaces and application prototypes from a brief.

why.zh: 把生成结果跑起来检查交互，而不只看截图。
why.en: Run the result and check interactions, not just its appearance.

summary.zh: 尝试中文搜索问答，并回到来源核对信息。
summary.en: Try Chinese search-assisted questions and verify information against sources.

why.zh: 练习区分模型回答和可核查的来源材料。
why.en: Practice distinguishing generated answers from verifiable source material.

summary.zh: 中文对话入口，可用于练习提问与比较回答。
summary.en: A Chinese chat entry point for practicing prompts and comparing answers.

why.zh: 同一道问题在不同助手上作答，观察差异并核实。
why.en: Compare assistants on the same question and check differences.

title.zh: ComfyUI 节点式生成工作流

summary.zh: 用节点连接生成式视觉模型与处理步骤。
summary.en: Connect generative vision models and processing steps with nodes.

why.zh: 把生图流程拆成可以观察和复用的组件。
why.en: Break image generation into visible, reusable components.

summary.zh: 将网页内容整理成适合模型处理的数据。
summary.en: Prepare web content for model-based processing.

why.zh: 适合为阅读和检索任务准备公开网页资料。
why.en: Prepare public web sources for reading and retrieval workflows.

summary.zh: 提供扩散模型的推理与训练组件。
summary.en: Inference and training components for diffusion models.

why.zh: 理解图像生成流水线以及不同组件的职责。
why.en: Explore image generation pipelines and their components.

summary.zh: 用图解逐步说明注意力与 Transformer 的组成。
summary.en: A visual walkthrough of attention and Transformer components.

why.zh: 在阅读原论文之前建立空间和数据流的直觉。
why.en: Build intuition for data flow before reading the original paper.

summary.zh: 通过文字与参考素材探索生成式图像。
summary.en: Explore image generation with text and reference material.

why.zh: 练习构图、风格与参考约束，同时检查结果偏差。
why.en: Practice composition, style and reference constraints while checking deviations.

summary.zh: 在本地集成语音识别、语音合成等音频能力。
summary.en: Integrate local speech recognition, synthesis and related audio capabilities.

why.zh: 适合需要离线或设备端语音功能的开发者。
why.en: Useful for offline or on-device speech applications.

summary.zh: 在本地运行视频和图像生成工作流。
summary.en: Run video and image generation workflows locally.

why.zh: 先核对显卡与模型要求，再从短片段开始。
why.en: Check hardware and model requirements before trying a short clip.

summary.zh: 在语音转写中加入词级时间戳与说话人区分流程。
summary.en: Add word-level timestamps and speaker diarization to speech transcription.

why.zh: 适合需要对齐音频的字幕和采访整理。
why.en: Useful for subtitles and interviews that need audio alignment.
